description: Four-quadrant empathy map visualization (Says, Thinks, Does, Feels) with optional flip-to-edit interaction

attributes.name: persona-id
attributes.description: Links the persona name to a user-persona element by id

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of a JSON record (title, persona, personaId, summary, quadrants, goals, painPoints). Fetched once per value; a newer value aborts the older request.

slots.name: persona
slots.description: Not projected: the text of a slot="persona" child is read as the persona name when the persona attribute is absent

slots.name: says
slots.description: Content for the Says quadrant (until the quadrant is edited)

slots.name: thinks
slots.description: Content for the Thinks quadrant (until the quadrant is edited)

slots.name: does
slots.description: Content for the Does quadrant (until the quadrant is edited)

slots.name: feels
slots.description: Content for the Feels quadrant (until the quadrant is edited)

slots.name: goals
slots.description: Optional goals summary below the grid

slots.name: pain-points
slots.description: Optional pain points summary below the grid

events.name: empathy-map:ready
events.description: Once per element, after the first render. With src, after the fetched data renders (not fired if the fetch fails). Not re-fired by later renders or moves.

events.name: empathy-map:update
events.description: When an open quadrant editor is closed (Done, Escape, or closeQuadrant()). Not fired when no editor is open.

events.name: empathy-map:upgraded
events.description: Once, in a microtask after first connect. Wait for this before assigning .data from a framework.
